# vcp_applications (Data Source)

Fetches a list of available applications. Can be optionally filtered by location.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List preinstalled applications. Optionally filter by location.
data "vcp_applications" "all" {}

data "vcp_applications" "by_location" {
  location_id = "kz"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `location_id` (String) Optional location ID to filter applications

### Read-Only

- `applications` (Attributes List) List of available applications (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--applications))

<a id="nestedatt--applications"></a>
### Nested Schema for `applications`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Application ID
- `images` (List of String) List of available images for this application
- `location_id` (String) Location ID where application is available
